crossRefs.note: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

translations.web: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
translations.bsb: Laban replied, “It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older.
translations.kjv: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
translations.asv: And Laban said, It is not so done in our place, to give the younger before the first-born.
